- Page 2 has line: "20.00% MWSt auf EUR 2'067.75" followed by "413.55" aligned with VAT amount. Interpretation:

  - VAT amount = 413.55 (number).
- Check subtotal: "Subtotal 2'067.75" matches net. Total = net + vat = 2067.75 + 413.55 = 2481.30 consistent.

6) Verify no other VAT groups present
- Individual line items show ARA fees with 0.9150 amounts (these are per-kg ARA fees, not VAT) and line-level surcharges; no other VAT percentage lines. Therefore one VAT group only.

7) Apply No Inference policy and formatting rules
- All values extracted correspond exactly to visible textual values.
- Vat.Rate should be a number without %, but keep decimals as in input: "20.00" (not "20").
- Net.Amount and Vat.Amount as numbers with same decimal places: 2067.75 and 413.55.
- Sender.VatId as string "ATU41612108".
- Invoice.Date as string "27.09.2023".
- GrandTotal.Amount as number 2481.30.

8) Edge cases considered
- Could Invoice.Date be "27. September 2023" or "29.SEP3023" (OCR errors)? I choose the clear machine-readable "27.09.2023" present next to invoice header on page 2. 
- Ensure not to use buyer UID (ATU22642807) — that belongs to recipient; sender UID is ATU41612108.

Conclusion: extraction values determined as above.
